NEET Re-exam Held Under Tight Security in Bhopal

The NEET re-examination was conducted across various centers with extensive security arrangements. In Bhopal, exam papers were retrieved from strong rooms under the watch of CRPF personnel and transported to examination centers. Strict guidelines, including a ban on electronic gadgets, were enforced for the 32 centers in the city.
